name: Arpa Industriale
note: Italian manufacturer of high-pressure laminate; owner of the Fenix brand used as Fenix-Premier Tech's title sponsor (Cyclist, 2026-07-14). Part of Broadview Holding, controlled by HAL Holding N.V.; all HAL Holding shares are held by HAL Trust, quoted on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange (arpaforinteriors.com group page, prnewswire.com 2018-12-17, halholding.com; claim arpa-broadview-hal-ownership).
